verse.verse_1: The craving for ever-greater worldly gains and to excel others in that regard keeps you occupied
verse.verse_3: Nay, you will soon come to know;
verse.verse_4: nay, again, you shall soon come to know.
verse.verse_5: Nay, would that you knew with certainty of knowledge (what your attitude will lead to, you would never have acted the way you do).
verse.verse_6: You will surely end up seeing Hell;
verse.verse_7: again, you shall most certainly end up seeing it with absolute certainty.
verse.verse_8: Then, on that Day, you will be called to account for all the bounties you enjoyed.
